python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.ListDetailView(%PARENT%)
control.setCompactThreshold(280)
control.setListPaneWidth(156)
list_layout = QVBoxLayout(control.listPane())
list_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 10, 12, 10)
list_layout.setSpacing(6)
list_title = fluentqt.Label("Inbox", control.listPane())
list_title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
list_sub = fluentqt.Label("Release checklist", control.listPane())
list_sub.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
list_sub.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
open_btn = fluentqt.Button("Open detail", control.listPane())
open_btn.clicked.connect(control.showDetail)
list_layout.addWidget(list_title)
list_layout.addWidget(list_sub)
list_layout.addStretch()
list_layout.addWidget(open_btn)
detail_layout = QVBoxLayout(control.detailPane())
detail_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 10, 12, 10)
detail_layout.setSpacing(6)
detail_title = fluentqt.Label("Release checklist", control.detailPane())
detail_title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
detail_body = fluentqt.Label("All automated checks passed across Light and Dark themes.", control.detailPane())
detail_body.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
detail_body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
detail_body.setWordWrap(True)
back_btn = fluentqt.Button("Back to list", control.detailPane())
back_btn.clicked.connect(control.showList)
detail_layout.addWidget(detail_title)
detail_layout.addWidget(detail_body)
detail_layout.addStretch()
detail_layout.addWidget(back_btn)
